[mysqld]
datadir=/srv/mariadb/data
socket=/srv/mariadb/run/mariadbd.sock
pid-file=/srv/mariadb/run/mariadbd.pid
port=25060
bind-address=*
server_id=799537875
gtid_domain_id=11
log_bin=binlog
log_slave_updates=ON
binlog_format=ROW
binlog_expire_logs_seconds=604800
ssl_ca=/srv/mariadb/tls/ca.crt
ssl_cert=/srv/mariadb/tls/server.crt
ssl_key=/srv/mariadb/tls/server.key
tls_version=TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3
plugin_load_add=auth_ed25519
performance_schema=ON
performance_schema_digests_size=10000
wsrep_on=ON
wsrep_provider=/usr/lib/galera/libgalera_smm.so
wsrep_cluster_name=db1
wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://10.0.0.1,10.0.0.2,10.0.0.3
wsrep_node_address=10.0.0.1
wsrep_node_name=10.0.0.1
wsrep_node_incoming_address=10.0.0.1:25060
wsrep_sst_method=mariabackup
wsrep_sst_auth=databasify_sst:rep"l
wsrep_gtid_mode=ON
wsrep_gtid_domain_id=1
wsrep_provider_options="socket.ssl_key=/srv/mariadb/tls/server.key;socket.ssl_cert=/srv/mariadb/tls/server.crt;socket.ssl_ca=/srv/mariadb/tls/ca.crt;gcache.size=1G"
innodb_autoinc_lock_mode=2
innodb_force_primary_key=ON
read_only=ON
back_log=256
innodb_buffer_pool_size=2560M
innodb_io_capacity=2000
innodb_io_capacity_max=4000
innodb_log_buffer_size=16M
innodb_log_file_size=640M
innodb_open_files=4000
innodb_purge_threads=1
innodb_read_io_threads=4
innodb_write_io_threads=4
max_connections=256
open_files_limit=65536
table_open_cache=4000
table_open_cache_instances=2
thread_cache_size=10

[sst]
ssl-mode=VERIFY_CA
